<!-- Fetch and save UTM from url last/first touch -->
<script>
  (() => {
    const paramGroups = {
      primary: ['utm_source', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_medium', 'utm_content', 'utm_term', 'utm_id', 'wbraid', 'campaign_id'],
      secondary: ['gclid', 'fbclid', 'ad_id', 'adset_id'],
    };

    const renameMap = {
      adset_id: 'facebook_adset_id',
      ad_id: 'facebook_ad_id',
    };

    // ===== Storage-safe wrappers =====
    // localStorage throws SecurityError when the browser denies DOM storage
    // (block-all-cookies mode, strict CMPs, Firefox strict ETP, Brave, etc.).
    // Every access is wrapped so a denial degrades to "no attribution" instead
    // of crashing the form submit that reads these values.
    const safeGetItem = (key) => {
      try {
        return localStorage.getItem(key);
      } catch (_) {
        return null;
      }
    };

    const safeSetItem = (key, value) => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
        return true;
      } catch (_) {
        return false;
      }
    };

    const safeRemoveItem = (key) => {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
      } catch (_) {
        /* denied — nothing to do */
      }
    };

    const safeParse = (raw) => {
      if (!raw) return {};
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};
      } catch (_) {
        return {};
      }
    };

    const toFieldArray = (obj) => Object.entries(obj).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }));

    // ===== Public helpers — INSTALL FIRST =====
    // Defined before any code that could throw at load time, so even if the
    // capture step below fails (denied storage on a UTM-carrying URL) the
    // submit handler still finds a callable function on window rather than
    // a TypeError.
    window.generateSubmissionGuid = () => {
      try {
        if (window.crypto?.randomUUID) return window.crypto.randomUUID();
      } catch (_) {
        /* fall through */
      }
      try {
        const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
        const hex = Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
        return `${Date.now().toString(16).slice(-8)}-${hex.replace(/(.{4})(.{4})(.{4})(.{12})/, '$1-$2-$3-$4')}`;
      } catch (_) {
        // Last-resort GUID: not cryptographically strong, but never throws.
        // The field only needs to be unique enough for HubSpot dedup.
        return `${Date.now().toString(16)}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10)}-fallback`;
      }
    };

    window.getPrimaryParams = () =>
      toFieldArray({
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('original_primary')),
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('last_touch_primary')),
      });

    window.getSecondaryParams = () =>
      toFieldArray({
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('original_secondary')),
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('last_touch_secondary')),
      });

    window.getAllAttributionParams = () =>
      toFieldArray({
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('original_primary')),
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('last_touch_primary')),
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('original_secondary')),
        ...safeParse(safeGetItem('last_touch_secondary')),
      });

    // ===== Capture step — safe to fail =====
    // Reads URL params, writes touch data to localStorage. If storage is
    // denied the form still submits (helpers above return []); we just don't
    // persist attribution for this visitor. That is strictly better than
    // freezing the button.
    try {
      const url = new URL(window.location.href);
      const params = url.searchParams;

      const getParamsFromUrl = (keys) => {
        const result = {};
        let found = false;
        keys.forEach((key) => {
          const value = params.get(key);
          if (value) {
            const mappedKey = renameMap[key] || key;
            result[mappedKey] = value;
            found = true;
          }
        });
        return found ? result : null;
      };

      const saveTouchData = (groupName, paramObj) => {
        if (!paramObj) return;

        const firstKey = `original_${groupName}`;
        if (!safeGetItem(firstKey)) {
          const formatted = {};
          Object.keys(paramObj).forEach((key) => {
            formatted[`original_${key}`] = paramObj[key];
          });
          safeSetItem(firstKey, JSON.stringify(formatted));
        }

        const lastKey = `last_touch_${groupName}`;
        safeRemoveItem(lastKey);
        safeSetItem(lastKey, JSON.stringify(paramObj));
      };

      const allKeys = [...paramGroups.primary, ...paramGroups.secondary];
      const hasAnyNewParams = allKeys.some((key) => params.has(key));

      if (hasAnyNewParams) {
        Object.entries(paramGroups).forEach(([groupName, keys]) => {
          const collected = getParamsFromUrl(keys);
          if (collected) {
            saveTouchData(groupName, collected);
          } else {
            safeRemoveItem(`last_touch_${groupName}`);
          }
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Outer guard: anything unexpected (URL parse, iteration) fails safely.
      // The public helpers above stay installed either way.
      console.warn('Attribution capture failed:', err);
    }
  })();
</script>

    const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('.fs-slider_instance');

      if (!nav) return;

      const slides = slider.querySelectorAll('[fs-slider-element="slide"]');

      const leftArrow = slider.querySelector('[fs-slider-element="previous"]');
      const rightArrow = slider.querySelector('[fs-slider-element="next"]');

      const paginationBullets = [...slider.querySelectorAll('.fs-slider_bullet')];
      if (paginationBullets.length === 1) {

        const width = window.innerWidth;
        if (width <= 767) return 1;

        // Hide entire nav if not enough slides to scroll
        if (totalSlides <= visibleCount) {

          return;
        }

        nav.style.display = '';

        // Let Finsweet's is-nav-disabled drive visibility
        if (leftArrow) leftArrow.style.visibility = leftArrow.classList.contains('is-nav-disabled') ? 'hidden' : 'visible';

      }

      updateNav();

      // Watch arrow class changes (Finsweet toggles is-nav-disabled)
      const observer = new MutationObserver(updateNav);
      if (leftArrow) observer.observe(leftArrow, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
      if (rightArrow) observer.observe(rightArrow, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });

      // Re-check on resize (visible count changes per breakpoint)
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateNav);
    });
